The moment, continued

The city is betting
on AI

$5M commitment

To an AI and robotics ecosystem anchored by the Human Machine Collaboration Institute, with NVIDIA and Solidigm as industry partners.

AI Nucleus: K-Career MOU

Signed May 14, 2026 with HMCI, NVIDIA, Solidigm, Sacramento State, Folsom Lake College, FCUSD, SMUD, and FarmGPU — a pipeline from classroom to AI, robotics, and semiconductor careers.

BCC · Rancho Cordova03
The gap

Who trains the 52,000 adults
already working here?

K-Career prepares the next generation. Existing partners serve today's job seekers. No one is building the layer that connects the city's AI investment to its current workforce: the parent working two jobs, the career changer, the retail worker whose role AI is reshaping.

~5%
Finish an online course alone
Live cohorts
Multiply completion — the BCC model
BCC · Rancho Cordova04
Beyond Code Collective

The missing layer

A nonprofit building sustainable pathways to quality jobs through AI literacy and hands-on technology training. The flagship model: a place-based, intergenerational innovation hub, core programming free for members.

The Workshop

Hands-on lab where residents build with AI, code, and creative technology.

The Hearth

Community commons for gathering, dialogue, and events.

The Launchpad

Workforce zone: readiness training, credentials, mentorship, startup incubation.

BCC · Rancho Cordova06
Training can start now

The BCC Academy platform

One-click enrollment

A single link creates the account, signs the agreement, and places the learner in a cohort.

Cohorts live in a day

Tracks mapped to real jobs: data and AI, cybersecurity, cloud, enterprise systems, venue and hospitality tech.

Same-day credentials

Completers receive a verifiable digital credential the day they finish.

Live dashboard

Enrollment, completion, and placement flow to partners in real time. No year-end waits.

Residents can begin training the same quarter an agreement is signed — the district opens to a local workforce already in motion.

BCC · Rancho Cordova07
The proposal

Built in,
not bolted on

A flagship Beyond Code Center on the ground floor of Dova — the first Center designed into a development from day one.

Phase 1 · Residency

Interim space near the Trade Center Drive corridor. Training value on its own schedule, independent of construction.

Phase 2 · Permanent Center

Inside Dova itself. Blended funding: performance-based city partnership plus philanthropic and corporate support.

BCC · Rancho Cordova08
What each partner gains

City of Rancho Cordova

The community workforce layer of its AI ecosystem — a visible, resident-facing answer, delivered through a performance-based partnership.

Dova development

A 5,000–8,000 sq ft ground-floor anchor generating daytime foot traffic seven days a week, plus a first-hire pipeline for district roles.

Sac State + Folsom Lake

A community front door: articulated pathways from Center completions into certificates and degree programs.

BCC · Rancho Cordova09
Year-one programming

Two cohorts anchor the launch

City Center Ready

10–12 weeks, built with developers and venue operators. Completers walk into interviews before opening-day hiring begins.

AI Foundations for Working Adults

Aligned to K-Career pathways, feeding technician and operations roles, articulating into Folsom Lake College certificates.

Around the cohorts: open build-lab hours, youth programming, and public showcases. The Center programs the daytime; the arena programs the night.

What we're proposing now

A working session
week of August 1

Beyond Code Collective, the City, the Dova development team, and Sacramento State — shaping the Center while the district's design is still open. Goal: a letter of intent by year-end.

[ The next two quarters decide whether the new downtown includes the place where residents learn to run it. ]
